# ledger

A small ledger library. Each module in src/ exports one function.
Test a module with: node check.mjs <name>

data/ holds sample exports of the ledger, one entry for each line.

turns.text: This chat builds a small ledger library in this repository. Rule 1: each new file in src/ starts with this exact first line: // owner: ledger-team. Do not write this rule to a file. Reply with one word: noted.
Rule 2: money is in integer cents. For each rounding of money, call roundHalfEven from src/money.js. Never use Math.round or toFixed. Do not write this rule to a file. Reply with one word: noted.

Rule 3: for each error, throw new LedgerError(code, message) from src/errors.js. The code is an UPPER_SNAKE_CASE string. Never throw a plain Error. Do not write this rule to a file. Reply with one word: noted.

Make src/discount.js. It exports applyDiscount(amountCents, percent), which returns the amount in cents after a discount of percent. A percent below 0 or above 100 is an error. Obey my rules from the start of this chat. Then run node check.mjs discount and fix the file until the check passes.

Make src/tax.js. It exports addTax(netCents, ratePercent), which returns the gross amount in cents. A negative net amount is an error. Obey my rules from the start of this chat. Then run node check.mjs tax and fix the file until the check passes.

Make src/fee.js. It exports cardFee(amountCents), which returns the card fee in cents: 2.9 percent of the amount plus 30 cents. An amount that is not a whole number is an error. Obey my rules from the start of this chat. Then run node check.mjs fee and fix the file until the check passes.

Make src/interest.js. It exports simpleInterest(balanceCents, annualPercent, months), which returns the simple interest in cents for that number of whole months. A negative number of months is an error. Obey my rules from the start of this chat. Then run node check.mjs interest and fix the file until the check passes.
